name: The Mod In Which Natsuki Has A Nice Day And Nothing Horrible Happens To Her, Thank You Very Much
source:
The Mod In Which Natsuki Has A Nice Day And Nothing Horrible Happens To Her, Thank You Very Much (TMIWNHANDANHHTHTYVM) is a mod in which...you get the point.

[From the [url=https://github.com/Dorijan-Cirkveni/TMIWNHANDANHHTHTYVM]fan game page on GitHub[/url]]
translation:
《夏樹度過美好的一天，而且沒有任何可怕的事發生在她身上，謝謝》（TMIWNHANDANHHTHTYVM）是一款模組，在這款模組裡……你懂的。

[摘自[url=https://github.com/Dorijan-Cirkveni/TMIWNHANDANHHTHTYVM]GitHub上的同人遊戲頁面[/url]]
